name: Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Yamato Holdings Co., Ltd. provides logistics shipping services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Express Business, Contract logistics Business, Global Business, Mobility Business, and Other segments. The Express Business segment engages in the truck transportation, and chartered roll box pallet transportation businesses, as well as provides home delivery services for individuals and corporate customers. The Contract and logistics Business segment engages in the third party and real estate business.
